description: This file defines a Java class 'Scenario2Nested1' which implements 'Scenario2Nested' interface. It sets up a specific scenario for testing permissions in a hierarchy of resources, focusing on READ and WRITE permissions for a Subject on a particular resource tree. It contains a constructor that initializes a 'ScenarioSetup' with specific authorization context and permission checks, and provides methods to access this setup and apply a permission-checking algorithm.
